info.name: Get Directions Between Two or More Locations

params.name: origin
params.description: The address, place ID (prefixed with place_id:), or latitude/longitude coordinates of the starting point.

params.name: destination
params.description: The address, place ID (prefixed with place_id:), or latitude/longitude coordinates of the ending point.

params.name: mode
params.description: The travel mode for calculating directions. Defaults to driving.

params.name: waypoints
params.description: An array of intermediate locations to include along the route, specified as pipe-separated values. Prefix with optimize:true to allow the Directions service to optimize the route by rearranging waypoints in a more efficient order. Each waypoint can be an address, place ID, or lat/lng pair.

params.name: alternatives
params.description: If set to true, instructs the Directions service to return more than one route alternative when available.

params.name: avoid
params.description: Indicates that the calculated route(s) should avoid the indicated features. Pipe-separated list of restrictions.

params.name: language
params.description: The language code in which to return results, where available.

params.name: units
params.description: Specifies the unit system to use when displaying results.

params.name: region
params.description: The region code, specified as a ccTLD two-character value. Biases results towards a particular region.

params.name: arrival_time
params.description: The desired arrival time for transit directions, specified as seconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC. Cannot be used with departure_time.

params.name: departure_time
params.description: The desired departure time, specified as seconds since midnight, January 1, 1970 UTC. For transit mode this is required if arrival_time is not specified. For driving mode with traffic_model, use "now" or a future timestamp.

params.name: traffic_model
params.description: The assumptions to use when calculating travel time in traffic. Only applies when mode is driving and departure_time is specified.

params.name: transit_mode
params.description: Specifies one or more preferred modes of transit as a pipe-separated list. Only valid when mode is transit.

params.name: transit_routing_preference
params.description: Specifies preferences for transit routes. Only valid when mode is transit.

items.docs: Calculates directions between an origin and a destination, optionally via waypoints. Supports driving, walking, bicycling, and transit modes. Returns one or more routes composed of legs and steps, including distance, duration, polylines, and turn-by-turn instructions.
